clue.text: Predict a teacher's second university will move ahead

indicators.note: moving ahead means this letter is shifted forward to an earlier place in the word

parts.note: a guru is a spiritual teacher; the 's is read as 'is', a link
U is the standard abbreviation for university, and here it is the second U in the teacher's title

explanation.surface: Someone forecasts that a teacher's second college post will go ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'second university' is not a degree but the second U of the teacher's title; 'will move ahead' shifts that letter forward.
explanation.definitionFit: To augur is to foretell or portend, a straight synonym for predicting.

clue.text: A dud apple unexpectedly well received

indicators.note: something happening unexpectedly comes out in an unforeseen form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Surprisingly, a rotten piece of fruit got a warm reception.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unexpectedly' rearranges all nine letters of A DUD APPLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something applauded was clapped and praised, that is, well received by its audience.

clue.text: Information needed on alien carnivore

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
ET is the film's extra-terrestrial, a standard crossword alien

explanation.surface: Data is required about an alien meat-eater.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'needed on' just places GEN above ET.
explanation.definitionFit: The genet is a small cat-like mammal of Africa and Europe that hunts prey, so it is a carnivore.

clue.text: Reserved new accommodation for retiring Italian

indicators.note: giving accommodation means housing a guest, so the first word takes the other inside it

parts.note: recent means new or fresh

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so this short abbreviation is turned to read backwards

parts.note: It is a common abbreviation for Italian, as in It vermouth

explanation.surface: A shy Italian who is withdrawing has had fresh lodgings booked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reserved' looks like booked accommodation, but it is the definition; 'retiring' reverses the Italian abbreviation, which 'accommodation for' houses inside the word for new.
explanation.definitionFit: A reticent person keeps their thoughts to themselves, so reserved is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Fragrant flowers need underground sprinklers

parts.note: the Tube is London's underground railway
a rose is the perforated sprinkler head on a watering can or hose

explanation.surface: Sweet-smelling blooms require watering devices placed below the soil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'underground' is not about soil but the London Tube, and the sprinklers are watering-can roses.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuberoses are Mexican plants grown for their heavily scented white flowers, used in perfumery.

clue.text: Some neat alcohol that's found in the bathroom

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A little undiluted spirit kept in the bathroom cabinet.
explanation.definitionFit: Talcum powder is a toiletry usually kept and used in a bathroom after bathing.

clue.text: Dandy fellow-soldiers whose contribution is vital

parts.note: a blood is an old word for a dashing, fashionable young man
a don is a fellow of a university college
OR stands for other ranks, the ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Smart comrades in arms whose part in the campaign is essential.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphen in 'fellow-soldiers' hides the split into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A donor's gift of blood can save a life, so the contribution is literally vital.

clue.text: The finest achievement — a hole in one?

definitions.meaning: the best performance ever, as in a world best
a vinyl disc has a hole at its centre for the turntable spindle

explanation.walkthrough: Golf's hole in one is the misdirection; the second sense is a gramophone disc with a hole in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A record is the best performance yet, and also a vinyl disc pierced by a central hole.

clue.text: Note with part of speech I'm turning up in bishop's office

indicators.note: in places the turned letters inside the bishop's office

parts.note: a see is a bishop's seat or diocese

indicators.note: in a down clue turning up reads the letters bottom to top, so both pieces are reversed

parts.note: a verb is one of the grammatical parts of speech
taken as written, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A remark on grammar that I'm bringing up in the bishop's study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' reverses VERB and IM together to MIBREV, which goes 'in' SEE.
explanation.definitionFit: A semibreve is the musical note worth four crotchets, called a whole note in America.

clue.text: Where pottery is made, keep the furnace going

definitions.meaning: the Potteries town in Staffordshire, England, famous for ceramics
to feed fuel to a fire or furnace

explanation.definitionFit: Stoke-on-Trent is England's pottery capital, and to stoke is to fuel a fire.

clue.text: Fine point unpolitic to fiddle with

indicators.note: fiddling with something means tampering with it, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A small detail that would be impolitic to tamper with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to fiddle with' rearranges the nine letters of UNPOLITIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A punctilio is a minute detail of conduct or etiquette, a fine point of procedure.

clue.text: Actor's brief role had no outcome?

definitions.meaning: a short appearance by a well-known performer
came to nought, O being zero

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is cryptic: split the answer as CAME plus O, the circle for zero.
explanation.definitionFit: A cameo is a small part played by a star; the split reading means came to nothing.

clue.text: Fix power supply to get in that broadcast

indicators.note: getting in means entering, so the supply goes inside the scattered word
broadcast means scattered widely, so these letters are spread into a new order

parts.note: AC, alternating current, is the mains power supply

explanation.surface: Arranging the electricity connection so a transmission can be received.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' turns THAT into ATTH, and AC is put 'to get in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: To attach is to fasten or fix one thing to another.

clue.text: Charming pub backed, serving a small portion outside

indicators.note: outside means the portion wraps around the reversed pub

parts.note: a dole is an old word for a small share handed out

indicators.note: backed means moved backwards, so the pub word is read in reverse

parts.note: a bar is a pub or the room in one where drinks are served

explanation.surface: The appealing tavern got support, serving one modest helping outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backed' reverses the pub, and 'outside' wraps the small portion round it; 'serving' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Adorable means delightful or lovable, so charming is a close synonym.

clue.text: Smartness of criminal deserter holding court up

indicators.note: holding means the rearranged letters contain the reversed abbreviation
something criminal is crooked, so the letters are bent into a new order
in a down clue up means the abbreviation is read from the bottom

explanation.surface: A felon who has fled the army, keeping the court waiting, shows street wisdom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' rearranges DESERTER into STREERED, 'up' turns CT into TC, and the first is 'holding' the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Street cred is fashionable standing among the young, a kind of hip smartness or credibility.

clue.text: What's said to be owed by old people needs setting off

indicators.note: said signals that the phrase is heard rather than read, so it is spoken aloud

parts.note: what pensioners cost the country, a debt on a nation

explanation.surface: Something reportedly owed by the elderly must be set off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What's said to be' introduces a phrase heard as 'debt on a nation', the burden of supporting the old.
explanation.definitionFit: Detonation is the act of setting off a bomb or charge so it explodes.

clue.text: Herb goes to a Spanish city

parts.note: tarragon is an aromatic herb used in French cooking

explanation.surface: A herb travels to a city in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Tarragona is a port city in Catalonia, on Spain's Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: Dress in red and black suits

definitions.meaning: a pack of playing cards, with its red and black suits

explanation.walkthrough: 'suits' looks like clothing beside 'Dress', but it means card suits.
explanation.definitionFit: To deck is to adorn or dress; a deck is also a pack of cards with four suits.

clue.text: Army leader sees a point in equipment and good food

parts.note: kit means gear or equipment

indicators.note: in means the compass point is placed inside the food

parts.note: cheer is an old word for food and drink, as in good cheer
N, north, is one of the compass points

explanation.surface: A general looks over a detail of the gear and fine fare.
explanation.walkthrough: Lord Kitchener was a British field marshal, famous from the 'Your Country Needs You' recruiting poster.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitchener commanded British armies and was Secretary of State for War in 1914.

clue.text: Art master often seen in the Remove

definitions.meaning: a wooden crate for packing household goods when moving house

explanation.walkthrough: Both halves look like school life (an art master, the Remove, a school form) but the answer is a packing crate used in a removal.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as old English, thou teachest; as a noun, a crate used for packing when people move.

clue.text: Appalling as board member is half-cut

indicators.note: half-cut means with half cut off, so only the first half of the word is kept

parts.note: a director sits on a company's board

explanation.surface: Disgraceful how a board member is tipsy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half-cut' is British slang for drunk, which gives the surface, but here it keeps DIRE from DIRECTOR.
explanation.definitionFit: Dire means dreadful or terrible, so appalling is a direct synonym.

clue.text: Need men out working, as plot must be finished

indicators.note: working means being worked into shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Workers are wanted on site because the scheme has to be completed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'working' rearranges the ten letters of NEED MEN OUT.
explanation.definitionFit: The final unravelling of a story is its resolution, where the plot is wrapped up.

clue.text: Like a person in recurrent alcoholic condition?

definitions.text: Like a person in recurrent alcoholic condition?

parts.words: Like a person in recurrent alcoholic condition?
parts.note: a drunk is in a state of intoxication; recurrent hints at being pelted again and again with missiles

explanation.walkthrough: The word means both very drunk and pelted with stones over and over.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for heavily intoxicated, describing a person in a drunken state.

clue.text: Pure character has trouble at first in town

indicators.note: in places the pieces inside the town word

parts.note: a city is a large town
taken as written

indicators.note: at first means only the opening letter of trouble is used

explanation.surface: A virtuous figure runs into problems early on in an urban setting.
explanation.walkthrough: HAS plus T, the first letter of 'trouble', goes 'in' CITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Chastity is sexual purity, so a pure character describes it.

clue.text: Family beginning to generate loud noise

parts.note: a clan is an extended family

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Relatives starting to make a racket.
explanation.walkthrough: G is the first letter of 'generate'.
explanation.definitionFit: A clang is a loud ringing metallic sound.

clue.text: Put an end to strong drink!

definitions.meaning: to ... a rumour is to stop or quash it

explanation.definitionFit: To scotch is to stamp out something; Scotch is whisky, a spirit.

clue.text: Hallucinate on drug that's rubbish

parts.note: to trip is to experience drug-induced hallucinations
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: Seeing things after taking a pill is no good.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' places TRIP above E.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripe is nonsense or worthless talk, rubbish in the figurative sense.

clue.text: Puppy's shrill cries rising? Have it sterilised!

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: yaps are the high barks of a small dog

explanation.surface: Your young dog keeps barking? Get it neutered!
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' reads YAPS upwards in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: To spay a female animal is to remove its ovaries, sterilising it; the imperative matches the command.

clue.text: Tree potentially has a grain

parts.note: corn is grain, the seeds of cereal crops

explanation.surface: Maybe a tree contains a seed.
explanation.definitionFit: An acorn is the nut of the oak, which may grow into a tree, hence potentially.

clue.text: Being full, theatre admitted none within

parts.note: rep is repertory theatre

indicators.note: within means the zero goes inside the admitted phrase

parts.note: let in means admitted
O, zero, means none

explanation.surface: The theatre was packed, letting nobody else inside.
explanation.walkthrough: O goes 'within' LET IN, after REP.
explanation.definitionFit: Repletion is the state of being completely filled or sated.

clue.text: One forebear, or two?

parts.note: a single grandfather, or else a grandmother plus a father written side by side

explanation.walkthrough: Read as one word it is a grandfather; split as GRAN and DADDY it is two relatives.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal name for a grandfather, who is one of a person's forebears.

clue.text: The endless rage of those people

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: endless means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: ire is anger or rage

explanation.surface: The never-ending fury of that crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts the E from IRE.
explanation.definitionFit: Their is the possessive meaning belonging to them, of those people.
